scientific_questions.Q1: Does regional refinement help when ROI localization is effectively ideal?
scientific_questions.Q2: Does the SAME regional refiner help when driven by frozen Stage-4D predicted proposals?
scientific_questions.Q3: What fraction of the oracle regional-refinement benefit is lost because of proposal quality?

B_oracle_regional.description: Regional refiner evaluated with ground-truth component ROIs (margin 0.25)

C_predicted_regional.description: Regional refiner evaluated with frozen Stage-4D predicted proposals
C_predicted_regional.purpose: Isolates proposal bottleneck in realistic end-to-end deployment

options_evaluated.OPTION_A1: Strict Oracle: Pure GT crops perfectly centered.
options_evaluated.OPTION_A2: Jittered Oracle: GT crops with spatial and scale jitter.
options_evaluated.OPTION_A3: Jittered Oracle + FP Background: GT crops with jitter, plus crops of empty background areas.
options_evaluated.OPTION_A4: Predicted Matching: Actual Stage-4D predicted crops.

training_roi_design.rationale: Option A3 is recommended. It cleanly separates the refiner from Stage-4D's specific error distribution, avoiding the training-domain confound of A4. Crucially, it uses jitter and empty crops to teach the single model to handle imperfect centering and suppress false-positive proposals at inference.

model_specifications.early_stopping: Patience 15 epochs on validation crop Dice
model_specifications.checkpoint_metric: Macro Dice per crop averaged across Oracle FULL_FIELD VAL crops. If both prediction and target empty, Dice=1.0. If prediction non-empty and target empty, Dice=0.0.
model_specifications.one_checkpoint: YES. Selected purely on Oracle VAL crop performance, evaluated on both.

fusion_rule.description: Pixelwise replacement with restored regional prediction inside proposal ROI; global UNet++ baseline prediction retained outside ROI.
fusion_rule.equation: P_final(x) = max_i(P_regional_i(x)) if x in union(ROIs) else P_global(x). Final mask M_final(x) = 1[P_final(x) >= 0.50].
fusion_rule.zero_proposal_rule: If 0 proposals, P_final = P_global everywhere. No synthetic or full-image fallback.

contrast_1.interpretation: Does regional refinement have potential when ROI localization is ideal?

contrast_2.interpretation: How much performance is lost due to imperfect proposal localization?

contrast_3.interpretation: Does the end-to-end predicted-ROI system improve over the global baseline?

proposed_diagnostic_gate.Step_1_Refiner_Potential: Contrast 1 (Oracle Regional) > Global Baseline. Tiny Recall@90 gain >= +0.05.
proposed_diagnostic_gate.Step_2_Proposal_Bottleneck: Contrast 2 (Predicted Regional) drop is < 50% of the Oracle gain from Step 1.
proposed_diagnostic_gate.Step_3_Practical_Net_Benefit: Contrast 3 (Predicted Regional) > Global Baseline. Tiny Recall@90 >= 0.78, Full Field Dice drop <= 0.02, Hard Tiny >= 2/16 recovered.
proposed_diagnostic_gate.Phase_15_Reopen_Rule: Reopen Phase 15 IF AND ONLY IF Step 1 and Step 3 are passed.

phase15_reopen_condition: Authorized ONLY if Phase 14 diagnostic achieves DIAGNOSTIC_PROMISING_SUPPORTING_REFINER.

geometry_ambiguity.phase12_margin25: Expanded GT bbox by 0.25 of its height/width on all sides (new_min = min - round(0.25 * span)).
geometry_ambiguity.stage4d_margin20: Uses identical mathematical rule (0.20 of span). Stage-4D apply_context_margin returns crop_geometry which is already expanded.
geometry_ambiguity.resolution: To prevent double-margin expansion, the refiner must consume the returned crop_geometry bounds directly from Stage-4D.

oracle_geometry_control.resolution: Oracle must be run using exactly margin=0.20 (not 0.25) to perfectly match Stage-4D context. Both use identical crop_and_preprocess(raw_image, crop_geom, target_size=256).

multiple_proposals.behavior: Crop, bilinear resize to 256, inference, bilinear restore to original scale.
multiple_proposals.overlap_rule: Pixel-wise MAX of the restored probability maps where proposals overlap. Thresholding occurs strictly after fusion.

fusion_rule.formula: P_fused = max(P_global, P_regional) for pixels inside ANY predicted proposal ROI, and P_global for pixels outside. Final threshold at 0.50.

oracle_multi_component.construction: Generate a separate Oracle ROI for each individual GT component using margin=0.20. Run inference on each separately, then MAX-fuse the probability maps to match the predicted pipeline.

crop_target.definition: The training target mask inside a crop contains ALL GT foreground pixels present within the crop boundary, not just the component that triggered the crop.

interpolation_rules.bbox_clipping: Hard clip to [0, height] and [0, width]

hyperparameter_provenance.architecture: Standard 4-stage U-Net (decoder channels [256, 128, 64, 32, 16], approx 1.9M params) to closely match Phase-10 UNet++ baseline capacity.
hyperparameter_provenance.channels: 32 initial filters, matching Phase-10 UNet++ baseline.
hyperparameter_provenance.crop_size: 256x256, standard medical size providing ~2x effective magnification (zoom) when applied to typical KUB calculus ROIs.

implementation_plan: Create src/data/regional_dataset.py implementing the Option A3 (Jitter + FP Background) crop generation strategy.
Create src/inference/regional_evaluator.py implementing the TopK=5 pipeline, deterministic overlap rule, and MAX fusion.

phase14_population.roi_crop_processing: NONE. Regional refiner does NOT process ROI_CROP images.
phase14_population.roi_crop_rule: ROI_CROP predictions remain exactly the frozen global UNet++ baseline.
phase14_population.hybrid_reporting: If combined KUB metric is reported, it must be labeled HYBRID DEVELOPMENT PIPELINE METRIC.

component_counts.oracle_topk_confound: PRESENT in TRAIN (max 11). Not present in VAL (max 5), but strictly matched budget rule must be defined.
component_counts.primary_oracle_budget_rule: If >5 GT components exist in an image, Primary Oracle TopK=5 subset is chosen deterministically by taking the 5 components with the largest pixel area. ORACLE_UNBOUNDED is an optional secondary metric.

perturbed_positive_rule.rationale: Simulate plausible bounding box noise (translation/scale) to teach the model to handle imperfect centering from Stage-4D without overfitting to Stage-4D exact predictions.

background_negative_rule.fallback: Skip generating negative crop for this image if valid zero-GT crop cannot be found.
background_negative_rule.rationale: Fixed prospective negative rate to balance training (approx 25-30% negatives) and force the model to learn to suppress false positive proposals, without mining specific errors.

training_design.expected_examples_per_epoch: 1162 (base) + 2324 (perturbed) + 1542 (negatives) = 5028. Epoch definition is fixed dynamically by one pass over all components and images.

diagnostic_gate_hierarchical.step_3_practical_signal: Tp >= 0.780822 AND Predicted FULL_FIELD Dice >= 0.632776 AND Hard Tiny >= 2/16 AND Global-empty >= 1/7
diagnostic_gate_hierarchical.threshold_rationale: Descriptive development gates to control resource expenditure on ablation, not TEST statistical claims. G>=0.05 requires clinically meaningful signal. R>=0.50 prevents optimizing refiner if proposal is binding bottleneck. Dice>=-0.02 tolerance prevents regression on large stones. Hard Tiny and Global-empty require qualitative breakthrough.
